comments.author: mashdoopster
comments.body_html:
Like the pre-built guns here. More “realistic” than some other progressive bot/loadout mods. Here is the main thing I have noticed:

I’ve played factory where I kill a PMC early on, and this backpack is already completely full. And each time the PMC has a residential labs card and often a tank battery, a rare key, and a bunch of other loot. I have questing bots installed, but haven’t seen this happen yet.

comments.author: K.V'7K'PVRIS
comments.body_html:
I don’t have this problem but if it can help you try it’s worth modifying in the config folder => config.json

‘looseLootMultiplier“: 1.2,

‘staticLootMultiplier“: 2,

‘increaseStaticLootKeysSpawn“: true,

‘increaseLooseLootKeysSpawn“: true,

‘increaseLooseLootCardsSpawn“: true,

‘increaseRareLootSpawn“: true,

by default it’s like this try to set everything to false and multiply try 1 I personally set everything to false because it’s closer to EFT LIVE

and in the lootingbot mod in the config.json file try to put this

‘pmcSpawnWithLoot“: false, if not already done
